prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / coherent production creature animation.
Image1 is the EXACT SINGLE OWN Elder Omen Hawk identity to animate, not a subject to redesign. Image2 is a primitive POSE AND SPACING GUIDE ONLY. Paint the mature hawk at each guide position, replacing all primitive shapes. Keep the tall cream three-tip crest from Image1 conspicuously tall in every pose, the broad layered brown/cream wing mantle, cream cheek/breast bib and long fanned dark tail. This is an aged and more developed small northern raptor, not a Roc, thunderbird, phoenix or Anivia. No gear, armor, aura, sparks or magical wings. Native grounded body about42pixels tall, fragile and compact. Original Heroes III painted/prerendered texture and upper-left light, restrained highlights and mild elevated right-facing three-quarter battlefield view.
Create EXACTLY6columns by8rows,48 separate complete bird bodies. Match the GUIDE'S WIDE CELL GUTTERS. Put each body at most60%of its cell area, with at least20%transparent margin at left/right and15%at top/bottom, including wings/tail. Entire sheet should have wide transparent outside border. No neighbor overlaps or wings cut at outer canvas edge. Fixed camera and one identical anatomical scale throughout the sheet. Flight wing spread may be larger than grounded body but must still fit each cell; do not enlarge each pose to its own cell. Target canvas1536x2048. Genuine transparent alpha outside bird, no color field, labels, grid, checkerboard, ground platform, scenery or text.
Rows counted top to bottom:
1 SIX true wingbeat phases: wings fully raised, half raised, horizontal, full downstroke, recovery half down, next upstroke. Tucked feet, real wing-joint articulation.
2 first2feather-check fidgets; third grounded folded-wing idle; final3hit recoils.
3 first3defensive wing braces; final3right-profile to three-quarter-front to frontal turn.
4 SIX true DEATH collapse poses, unlike the simple guide: stagger upright, topple side, roll onto back, settle low, head rests sideways, final fully prone lifeless bird with folded wings and relaxed feet. All body/tail visible. The bird must actually die, not keep standing or fly in these six cells.
5 SIX diagonal-up beak/talon attacks, with anticipation, windup, contact, followthrough and recovery.
6 SIX level beak/talon attacks, different real level contact direction.
7 SIX diagonal-down talon attacks, different lowered contact direction.
8 first3TAKEOFF: crouched folded bird, wings opening, feet lifting; final3LANDING: lowering feet, ground contact, folded standing. Each action is actual anatomy, not translated idle copies.
Use the same taller cream crest and fuller wing/tail silhouette in EVERY cell. Feather colors stay natural brown, dark gray barring and cream. No owl head, eagle-rider tack or giant monster proportions. Ignore the guide's gray shapes in final paint. Complete all48poses with consistent model details.
